# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 3, Second Rome vs Third Rome (oe_rom3_, slot 48). Generated by gen_third_rome.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Increment sent counter safely.
oe_rom3_inc_sent = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rom3_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
}

# Any scope. Refresh live Second Rome (BYZ/ROM), Constantinople state (1 holds / 2 exile / 3 fallen), and leading Orthodox Rus' host.
oe_rom3_resolve_hosts = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_byz }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_byz value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_byz }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_byz }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_byz value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_byz }
    }
    else = {
        remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_byz
    }

    if = {
        limit = { oe_rp2_byz_holds_city = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_city_state value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_rp2_byz_in_exile = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_city_state value = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_city_state value = 3 }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { oe_rp2_has_live_player = yes global_var:oe_rp2_player = { oe_rom3_rus_risen = yes } }
        global_var:oe_rp2_player = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_rus value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_rpl_has_live_player = yes global_var:oe_rpl_player = { oe_rom3_rus_risen = yes } }
        global_var:oe_rpl_player = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_rus value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { oe_rom3_rus_risen = yes } }
        c:RUS = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_rus value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MOS c:MOS = { oe_rom3_rus_risen = yes } }
        c:MOS = { save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_rus value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
    }
    else = {
        culture_group:russian_group = {
            ordered_country_in_culture_group = {
                limit = { oe_rom3_rus_risen = yes }
                order_by = total_population
                max = 1
                save_scope_as = oe_rom3_tmp_rus
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_rus value = scope:oe_rom3_tmp_rus }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply a bilateral static modifier to both Second Rome and Third Rome hosts (always includes root).
oe_rom3_apply_bilateral_mod = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rom3_has_byz = yes NOT = { this = global_var:oe_rom3_byz } }
        global_var:oe_rom3_byz = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rom3_has_rus = yes NOT = { this = global_var:oe_rom3_rus } }
        global_var:oe_rom3_rus = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply a bilateral opinion bias between Second Rome and Third Rome hosts when both exist and differ.
oe_rom3_apply_bilateral_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_rom3_has_byz = yes
            oe_rom3_has_rus = yes
            NOT = { global_var:oe_rom3_byz = global_var:oe_rom3_rus }
        }
        global_var:oe_rom3_byz = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = global_var:oe_rom3_rus } }
        global_var:oe_rom3_rus = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = global_var:oe_rom3_byz } }
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization of Second vs Third Rome post-1470.
oe_rom3_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_path value = 0 }
    oe_rom3_resolve_hosts = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rom3_has_rus = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Public monthly entry point for reserved scheduler slot 48 (gen_mainline_lock.py).
# Runs BOTH Second/Third Rome (oe_rom3_) AND Playable Rus' Phase 2 (oe_rp2_monthly) cleanly and idempotently!
oe_rom3_monthly = {
    oe_rp2_monthly = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_m value = oe_rom3_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1470
            NOT = { global_var:oe_rom3_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_rom3_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_ran_m value = global_var:oe_rom3_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rom3_init } }
            oe_rom3_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                global_var:oe_rom3_end ?= 8
                current_year <= 1602
            }
            oe_rom3_resolve_hosts = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_rom3_has_rus = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rom3_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1605 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 3 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_on
            }
            else = {
                oe_rom3_resolve_hosts = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_rom3_has_rus = yes }
                    oe_rom3_dispatch_events = yes
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_rom3_test_clear = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_init
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_on
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_end
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_m
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_ran_m
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_ev_m
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_byz
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_rus
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_city_state
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_path
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_sent_cnt
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_epistle_done
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_byz_replied
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_concordat_signed
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_rivalry_peak
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_translatio_done
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_patriarchate_done
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_done
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_1
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_2
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_3
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_4
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_5
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_6
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_7
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_8
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_fired_9
    remove_variable = oe_rom3_job
    remove_variable = oe_rom3_embassy_cd
    remove_variable = oe_rom3_primacy_done
    remove_variable = oe_rom3_claim_done
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_twin_lights_proposal
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_northern_primacy_claim
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_twin_eagles_concordat
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_greek_typographers
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_new_rome_primacy
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_eagle_rivalry_duel
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_exclusive_orthodoxy
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_conciliar_settlement
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_third_rome_mantle
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_humble_guardianship
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_all_rus_patriarchate
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rom3_detachment_focus
}

oe_rom3_test_start = {
    oe_rom3_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_path value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rom3_m value = oe_rom3_m_now }
    oe_rom3_resolve_hosts = yes
}

oe_rom3_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_rom3_ran_m
    oe_rom3_monthly = yes
}

oe_rom3_test_me_1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rom3_on } } oe_rom3_test_start = yes }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rom3.1
}

oe_rom3_test_me_2 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rom3_on } } oe_rom3_test_start = yes }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rom3.2
}
